notes: Predefined scan whitelist and blacklist for safe cleanup operations. Whitelist: only scan these known-safe directories. Blacklist: system core areas that must never be scanned. Use with -ScanMode fast/standard/deep to control scan depth.

whitelist.description: Directories that are safe to scan and clean. Only these paths (and their subdirectories) will be scanned when whitelist mode is enabled. Paths use environment variables for portability.

entries.name: User Temp Directories
entries.description: Standard user temporary files; safe to clean

entries.name: Browser Caches (Edge, Chrome, Firefox)
entries.description: Regenerable browser caches; close browsers first

entries.name: Developer Tool Caches
entries.description: Regenerable build/package caches for development tools

entries.name: Application Caches (Notion, Discord, Teams, etc.)
entries.description: Regenerable Electron app caches; content is server-side

entries.name: GPU Shader Caches (NVIDIA, AMD, DirectX)
entries.description: Shader compilation caches; regenerate on next app/game launch

entries.name: Windows System Caches (Thumbnails, Icons, Prefetch, Delivery Optimization)
entries.description: Windows system caches; some require admin; Prefetch rebuilds on app launch

entries.name: Windows Logs (CBS, DISM, WER, Event Logs via wevtutil)
entries.description: System diagnostic logs; safe to remove unless troubleshooting

entries.name: Game Launcher Caches (Steam, Epic, Riot)
entries.description: Game launcher logs and embedded browser caches

entries.name: AI/ML Tool Caches (Ollama, LM Studio, HuggingFace)
entries.description: AI tool logs and Electron caches; model weights are NOT in these paths

entries.name: Media Creation Tool Caches (OBS, CapCut, Jianying)
entries.description: Media editor caches and logs; projects are not stored here

entries.name: Office Suite Caches (WPS, Microsoft Office)
entries.description: Office temporary caches and addon caches

entries.name: Communication App Caches (WeCom, QQ, WeChat, DingTalk)
entries.description: IM client logs and caches; chat data is server-side

entries.name: UWP App TempState (All Store Apps)
entries.description: Per-app temporary state for packaged (Store/UWP) apps; apps recreate as needed

entries.name: Docker Desktop Logs
entries.description: Desktop client logs only; use 'docker system prune' for container cleanup

entries.name: Cloud Sync Logs (OneDrive, Dropbox, Google Drive)
entries.description: Sync client logs; sync content unaffected

entries.name: Recycle Bin
entries.description: Native Clear-RecycleBin cmdlet; permanently empties Recycle Bin

blacklist.description: System core areas that must NEVER be scanned or cleaned. Patterns are REGEX matched against the lowercased absolute path (engine GuardPatterns style, path-segment form so they match both normalized and absolute paths). Any rule matching these paths is filtered out at scan time AND demoted to dangerous+disabled during merge. The engine additionally unions its own deletion-point GuardPatterns with this list (defense in depth).

entries.name: WinSxS Component Store
entries.reason: Windows component store; only safe cleanup is DISM StartComponentCleanup (advisory only)

entries.name: System Drivers & Driver Store
entries.reason: Kernel drivers and driver repository; deletion breaks hardware support

entries.name: Windows Installer Cache
entries.reason: MSI package cache; deletion prevents uninstall/repair of installed apps

entries.name: Windows Core System Directories
entries.reason: Core OS directories; direct deletion destroys the operating system

entries.name: Pagefile, Swapfile, Hiberfil
entries.reason: Memory management files; direct deletion causes system crash/corruption

entries.name: User Registry Hives
entries.reason: User registry hives; deletion destroys user profile

entries.name: Boot Files & BCD
entries.reason: Boot configuration data; deletion makes system unbootable

entries.name: Core System Executables
entries.reason: Critical system binaries; deletion breaks OS functionality

entries.name: Event Log Files (.evtx)
entries.reason: Event log files; must use wevtutil to clear, never delete .evtx directly

entries.name: Windows.old (Previous Installation)
entries.reason: Previous Windows installation; deletion prevents rollback. Use Disk Cleanup (cleanmgr) instead

entries.name: Program Files (Application Binaries)
entries.reason: Installed application binaries; deletion breaks installed software

entries.name: System32 DLLs & Critical Libraries
entries.reason: Critical system libraries; deletion causes system instability

entries.name: Driver Configuration
entries.reason: Driver INF files; deletion breaks driver installation/management

entries.name: WMI Repository
entries.reason: WMI repository; corruption breaks system management

entries.name: Windows Servicing Stack
entries.reason: Servicing stack for updates; deletion breaks Windows Update

entries.name: Windows Recovery Environment
entries.reason: Recovery partition/environment; deletion breaks system recovery

entries.name: EFI System Partition
entries.reason: UEFI boot partition; deletion makes system unbootable

scanModes.description: Scan mode configurations that control how aggressively the whitelist/blacklist is applied

fast.description: Quick scan - only whitelist directories, no deep recursion

standard.description: Standard scan - whitelist directories with moderate recursion

deep.description: Deep scan - full whitelist recursion with blacklist enforcement

diagnostic.description: Diagnostic scan - scan all but report blacklist hits (for audit)
